rationale: The workflow is a single `test` job (push + pull_request) that checks out the repo and runs shell scripts; repository CI history shows successful runs completing in roughly 13–16 minutes. The only measured workflow_yaml evidence that could apply is the job-timeout pattern (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT / P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT), whose artifacts add `timeout-minutes: 5` and report measured savings on forks. However, a 5-minute limit is shorter than this workflow's valid run duration, triggering the explicit contraindication "Valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit"; applying it would kill valid test runs and reduce coverage. Other patterns do not apply: there is no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) and no dependency-installation step to cache (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE). No safe, evidence-supported change preserves the intended coverage, so NO_CHANGE.
